### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**8** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **18** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c02fa12767eeee8ffde3ff7e48830c182df2118f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9fd2d2ab03b163ca23946f9de3732a9901578d09` — the merge of head `2a0d7da0b1f5db3feb5d587fb73f7bc2297582f1` into base `c02fa12767eeee8ffde3ff7e48830c182df2118f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9fd2d2ab03b163ca23946f9de3732a9901578d09 && git checkout 9fd2d2ab03b163ca23946f9de3732a9901578d09
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c02fa12767eeee8ffde3ff7e48830c182df2118f 2a0d7da0b1f5db3feb5d587fb73f7bc2297582f1 && git checkout -B drift-repro c02fa12767eeee8ffde3ff7e48830c182df2118f && git merge --no-ff 2a0d7da0b1f5db3feb5d587fb73f7bc2297582f1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c02fa12767eeee8ffde3ff7e48830c182df2118f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2a0d7da0b1f5db3feb5d587fb73f7bc2297582f1`

Scope: PR #20243 (card #20212, p2, `area:access`), 8 files, +570/−27, base = merge base with `origin/main` `615c468746`; read from detached worktrees of head and base, each closure built (`turbo run build`, exit 0 both). The branch's merge of `main` at `f3eb1d06c4` brought 3 commits (`805af4f290..615c468746`, 33 files) — intersection with the PR's 8 files: none (the two `packages/spec/src/data` files it carried are `filter.zod.ts` / `filter-like-code-point.test.ts`, not the comparand-shape face). Inputs: card + comments 5854946815 / 5855172230 / 5855751762 / 5856443791 (treated as claims) / 5856466622; PR body, diff, check-runs; contract-review.md, landing-operations.md, AGENTS.md from `origin/main`. Probe: real `SecurityPlugin` + `ObjectQL`, MEMBER `usr_member`, rows `r_open` / `r_closed` / `r_none`(NULL), 79 cells × {InMemoryDriver (dist), SqlDriver/SQLite, SqlDriver/PostgreSQL 16.13 (private role+db, started with `pg_ctlcluster 16 main start`)} × {base, head}; results JSON-diffed. Worktrees removed, role/db dropped, cluster stopped.

### ① Derived judgments
- **Rows (item 1) — bar met on all three drivers.** Head, each of `!(status in ['open',null])`, `status in ['open',null]`, `status > null`, `status <= null`, `status in [null]`: `find` `[]`, `findOne(r_closed)` `null`, `count` 0, `getReadFilter` = `__rls_deny__` sentinel, `explain` rls `denies`, exactly one `[RLS] DENY (fail closed)` WARN with `reason: 'refused-comparand'`, same WARN template as the control (`== current_user.positions` → `unsupported`); `check`: insert open / closed / NULL and by-id update all `PERMISSION_DENIED/403`, nothing stored, one DENY WARN (`check` clause). Read and check agree in every cell; field-for-field equal to the type-family control (assert script: `ALL NULL-FAMILY CELLS MEET THE BAR`, memory / sqlite / pg). Base reproduces the card: P1 read `[r_none]` on SQLite and PG (hides `r_closed`), `[r_closed]` on memory, while its check admitted `closed` insert and the update; P2 and P5 admitted a NULL insert. PG answered as SQLite in every base cell.
- **Seam (item 2) — `compileFilter` covers the three doors.** `using`: `computeLayeredRlsFilter` → `compileFilter(…,'using')` (security-plugin.ts:7077); `check`: `computeWriteCheckFilter` → `compileFilter(…,'check')` (:7343) → `matchesFilterCondition` (:3167); analytics: `getReadFilter` → `computeRlsFilter` → same Layer-1 compile (:5240, :6774) — measured: head `getReadFilter` answers the sentinel for all five. Other `ast.where` composers, judged from code: tenant Layer 0 `{organization_id: id}` / `{$in: ids}` (tenant-layer.ts:177-179), controlled-by-parent `{fk: {$in: ids}}` (:7741-7767), plugin-sharing `buildReadFilter` `{owner}` / `{id: {$in: grantedIds}}` / `{id:'__deny_all__'}` (sharing-service.ts:441-484), attachment/comment hooks `{parent_object, parent_id: {$in: visible}}`, engine search filter from the search string — none carries an authored comparand. **Finding (out of scope):** a sharing rule's authored CEL `condition` lowers through the same `compileCelToFilter` and CAN carry a null list member into `criteria_json`, but it is consumed as an engine `find` `filter` under a system context (sharing-rule-service.ts:1219-1233), i.e. through the caller-`where` seam — measured on all drivers, base and head: `INVALID_FILTER/400`, which that method catches as `[sharing-rule] criteria query failed` and matches no rows (fail closed, inert rule). No authored comparand reaches a driver unjudged.
- **No collateral (item 3).** 60 of 79 cells byte-identical base→head per driver (rows, write answers, RLS/Security lines, `getReadFilter`, `explain`, analytics faces); the 19 differing cells are exactly the null-family ones (P1–P5 ×2 clauses, P1+sibling ×2, P2+C1 ×2, P3+sibling read, P1+P2 ×2, tenant-scoped P1 ×2). Spread covered `==`, `!=`, lists ± negation, `>`, `<=`, range, `== null`/`!= null`, `startsWith`/`endsWith`/`contains`, `in current_user.org_user_ids` ± negation, `current_user.id` ==/!=, `||`, `&&`, `true`, emptied membership (`empty-membership`), undeclared column (`unknown-field`), unresolved key (`unresolved-variable`), arithmetic (uncompilable WARN), tenant-scoped object (posture `isolated`; memory refuses `MEMORY_MULTI_TENANT_UNSUPPORTED` at base and head alike). Caller's own `where` with `$in [open,null]`, `$not` of it, `$gt null`, `$lte null`, array form: `INVALID_FILTER/400`, message byte-identical; `{status: null}`, `$ne null`, `$null` unchanged. Existing DENY paths: 14/14 cells identical WARN count and wording; uncompilable WARN identical (5 lines). Multi-policy: P1+`status=='open'` at head reads `[r_open]` with **no** WARN, check admits open / refuses closed — identical to C1+sibling; P2+C1 and P1+P2 → DENY with two WARN lines (`refused-comparand`,`unsupported` / `refused-comparand`×2), same as C1+C2's two `unsupported` lines. `explain`: `narrows`→`denies` for P1–P5 on the plain object (= control). Analytics, fed the measured `getReadFilter`: base scopes → `READ_SCOPE_COMPILE_FAILED/500` on the ObjectQL-face judge (`assertReadScopeComparandsRunnable`) and on `compileScopedFilterToSql` (native + echo); head → runnable, SQL `"t"."id" = ?`, `aggregate` count 0; P1+sibling: base 500 → head sibling rows (count 1). Judged a correction (one policy, one fail-closed answer on the data and the analytics path; the 500 was a withheld server fault for an authored policy) and disclosed: 20212 changeset "Analytics:" bullet, the 20018 correction, PR Acceptance notes.
- **Failure handling (item 4).** With `@objectstack/spec/data` mocked to throw on marker fields: bare `Error`, `Error` with `code` but no `status`, non-`Error` object, thrown string → `compileFilter` throws, returns nothing, logs no WARN; enveloped (`Error` + string `code` + numeric `status`) → `RLS_DENY_FILTER` + one `refused-comparand` WARN. Real stack: `find` and `insert` reject with the bare error (no silent drop); `getReadFilter`'s pre-existing catch-all still answers the sentinel with an `error`-level `[security] getReadFilter failed … denying (fail-closed)` line — unchanged by this PR, not silent. WARN text: `… (using clause, refused-comparand): the compiled predicate carries a comparand the platform's shared filter faces refuse (INVALID_FILTER), so the policy was not handed to a driver. In the face's own words, written for a caller's filter: Operator "$in" on field "status" does not accept null as a list member (at where.$not.status.$in[1]). … Every applicable policy dropped, so the request is filtered by RLS_DENY_FILTER … Predicate: !(record.status in ['open', null])` — names operator, field, position and remedy; the existing DENY lines already echo the full predicate and the compiler's detail (variable path, member index, column), so nothing beyond; server-side log only.
- **Pins discriminate (item 5).** Unablated: 2 files, 84 passed. Ablation `const comparands = judgeCompiledComparands(outcome.filter);` → pass-through: blob `2438357788` → `e6a410b0b5` (matches the dev), **42 failed / 42 passed of 84**, every failure a null-family `→ RLS_DENY_FILTER, one refused-comparand WARN` cell. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`: blob `2438357788d9c841de78d83d18694e1308c6b2fa`, `git status --porcelain` clean.
- **Scope and merge (item 8).** Diff touches nothing under `packages/spec`, `packages/formula`, any driver `src/`, `packages/objectql`, `packages/services/service-analytics`. Added code lines contain no null test on a comparand (`judgeCompiledComparands` only calls the two faces and routes the envelope; lint adds prose only). `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main(ab820016b3) 2a0d7da0b1` → tree `118167766d59236878d26992bb89d43b7db0ebc5`, exit 0, no conflicts.
- **Prose (item 7).** PR body: every measured claim checked against my cells — the base table (memory / sqlite / pg), "PostgreSQL answered as SQLite", the P2/P5 NULL-insert line, the multi-policy line, the caller-`where` line, the ablation numbers, both gate outputs — TRUE; no FALSE sentence found. Changeset `20212`: table, "What now answers differently", "Unchanged", "Who is affected" (`git grep` at head: the only `using`/`check` strings naming `null` outside tests are null checks) — TRUE; one imprecision (below). `19951` correction: old→new is one line (numstat 1/1), the new sentence "The RLS compiler runs that check on its own filter too (#20212) and drops the policy on every request: reads return no rows and `check` writes are refused 403" — TRUE at head (lone-policy frame, same frame as the type-family sentence above it); every other line byte-identical. `20018` correction: one wrapped sentence (numstat 2/2), "the RLS compiler drops such a policy (#20212), so the analytics faces receive the deny sentinel and answer zero rows" — TRUE at head (measured sentinel → `"t"."id" = ?` → 0); every other line byte-identical. Other pending notes (RLS, lint, analytics read-scope, comparand faces: 19974, 19975, 19995, 20010, 20035, 20039, 20068, 20157, analytics-row-scope-*, rls-*): none asserts the RLS layer skips the faces or that such a policy reaches a backend; none reads FALSE. Lint message at head (printed for `using` and `check`): "`RLSCompiler` DROPS the policy on EVERY request: it runs that same check on every compiled policy filter, before any backend sees it. The shape check passes, so the "uncompilable predicate" WARN is never logged; the only signal is a per-request "DENY (fail closed)" WARN, emitted only when nothing else applicable compiles" + the clause consequence — each clause TRUE against the measured cells; no tracker number in the runtime string. Lint test file: 120 passed at head.
- **The ruling's three acceptances hold on measurement:** seam `compileFilter` (covers `using`, `check`, `getReadFilter`, no other authored-comparand composer); SqlDriver-only real-stack pin beside the unit pin (InMemoryDriver and PG re-measured here, base and head, consistent with the PR table); `packages/lint` widening (its old message was FALSE at head).

### ② Semver level
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — correct: reads that returned rows return 0, checks that admitted now 403; no new key on a published payload. `refused-comparand` is a member of the non-exported `RlsDropReason` type, appears only as a runtime WARN-meta string; `dist/index.d.ts` / `.d.mts` carry 0 occurrences; `index.ts` exports only `RLSCompiler`, `RLS_DENY_FILTER`; `compileFilter` signature unchanged. No widening arm needed.
- `@objectstack/plugin-security: minor` with `**BREAKING**` banner under the launch-window convention; `@objectstack/lint: patch` (message text of an existing finding, rule id unchanged) — consistent with the changeset. `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base 615c468746 --event ev.json` (current PR body, 12992 bytes): "✓ This diff introduces no `major` bump. ✓ LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `no (narrowing)`, and it grades a package whose `packages/**/src/**` it moves at `minor` or above — the declared narrowing is accounted for: - @objectstack/plugin-security: minor … · direction arm: `narrowing` — a BREAKING change; during the launch window it ships `minor`" exit 0.
- ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base 615c468746`: "✓ check-adr-0087-registration: 1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition. .changeset/20212-rls-compiled-filter-comparand-faces.md [BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription) reason: an enforcement change in the RLS compiler: no authorable key, spelling or stored shape moves …" exit 0. Consistent with the two shapes having been ruled at the face with no ledger entry.

### ③ Boundary flags
- Open question 1 (InMemoryDriver pin) → **C confirmed**: refusal happens in the compile step; InMemoryDriver measured here base/head (P1 base `[r_closed]`, head `[]` + WARN), consistent with the PR; a `check:driver-memory-census` consumer ruling is not worth one cell.
- Open question 2 (two DELIBERATE CORRECTIONS) → **A confirmed**: both new sentences TRUE at head, every other line byte-identical; this same-head PASS record is the confirmation `check-empty-changeset` asks for.
- Deviations (seam, SqlDriver-only pin, `packages/lint` off the claim surface): accepted, each judged above.
- **CI at head (item 9):** 34 check runs, 30 `success`, 3 `skipped` (Console Pin Gate, Build Docs, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)), 1 `failure`. Required contexts all `success`: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build Core, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Governed Surface Queue Guard. The one failure is `Check Changeset`, red by design on exactly the two corrected notes — log: "This PR adds 1 changeset(s), so it declares a release of its own. … ✓ No empty-frontmatter changeset introduced by this diff … `##[error].changeset/19951-rls-lint-per-request-refusals.md exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR, so changing or deleting it silently replaces somebody else's release note (#17712). … DELIBERATE CORRECTION -- your change may have made this PENDING release note false, and you rewrote it in the same stroke. Remedy: do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed`", and the identical line for `.changeset/20018-native-read-scope-faces.md`. No other failure.
